[If](bikeshed:=If=) [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) is odd
[file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=) is the dictionary used by the block that [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) refers to as a 1-based index, or zero if no dictionary is used.
segments.translation: [file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=)는 [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=)이 가리키는 블록이 사용하는 사전을 1부터 시작하는 인덱스로 나타낸 것이며, 사전을 사용하지 않으면 0입니다.

segments.source: Therefore [file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=) = |k| refers to the block at [dictionary_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/dictionary_offsets=)[|k| - 1], and [num_dictionaries](bikeshed:=meta/num_dictionaries=) is the maximum possible value for it.
segments.translation: 따라서 [file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=) = |k|는 [dictionary_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/dictionary_offsets=)[|k| - 1]에 있는 블록을 가리키며, [num_dictionaries](bikeshed:=meta/num_dictionaries=)는 이 값이 가질 수 있는 최댓값입니다.

segments.source: A relative offset to the corresponding [leaf block](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=), which starts the file's [parcel](bikeshed:=parcel=), is recorded as [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=), plus 1 if the file is another output of the block than the output 0.
segments.translation: 파일의 [파셀](bikeshed:=parcel=)을 시작하는 해당 [리프 블록](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=)까지의 상대 오프셋이 [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=)으로 기록되며, 파일이 블록의 출력 0이 아닌 다른 출력이면 여기에 1을 더합니다.

segments.source: The relative offset can't be zero.

Since every relative offset is even, [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) % 2 tells which: the <dfn>file output index</dfn> is 0 if [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) is even, and [file_output](bikeshed:=meta/file_output=) + 1 if it is odd.
segments.translation: 모든 상대 오프셋은 짝수이므로 [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) % 2로 어느 경우인지 알 수 있습니다: [file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=)이 짝수이면 <dfn>파일 출력 인덱스</dfn>는 0이고, 홀수이면 [file_output](bikeshed:=meta/file_output=) + 1입니다.

segments.source: Multiple files MAY refer to the same leaf block and output, in which case they have the same content.
segments.translation: 여러 파일이 같은 리프 블록과 출력을 가리킬 수 있으며, 이 경우 그 파일들은 같은 내용을 가집니다.

segments.source: This is how an archive stores files with the same content only once, including files that were hard links to each other ([[#link-groups]]).
segments.translation: 이것이 서로 하드 링크였던 파일들([[#link-groups]])을 포함하여, 아카이브가 같은 내용의 파일을 한 번만 저장하는 방식입니다.

segments.source: It costs only a [file_param](bikeshed:=meta/file_param=) and an [entry](bikeshed:=meta/entry=) per file.
segments.translation: 이 방식은 파일당 [file_param](bikeshed:=meta/file_param=) 하나와 [엔트리](bikeshed:=meta/entry=) 하나만 소요됩니다.

segments.source: Entry structure (<dfn>entry</dfn>) then occurs for each directory, file and special entry, in this order, and consists of the following:
segments.translation: 그다음 엔트리 구조(<dfn>엔트리</dfn>)가 각 디렉터리, 파일, 특수 엔트리마다 이 순서대로 나타나며, 다음으로 구성됩니다:

segments.source: Name
Type
Conditions
entry_name
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[*] ≠ 0
entry_name_sentinel
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=) = 0
original_size
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a file
special_kind
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a special entry
segments.translation: [If](bikeshed:=If=) 이 엔트리가 특수 엔트리에 대한 것임

segments.source: link_target
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[*] ≠ 0
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a special entry and [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) = 1
segments.translation: [If](bikeshed:=If=) 이 엔트리가 특수 엔트리에 대한 것이고 [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) = 1임

segments.source: link_target_sentinel
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=) = 0
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a special entry and [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) = 1
segments.translation: [If](bikeshed:=If=) 이 엔트리가 특수 엔트리에 대한 것이고 [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) = 1임

segments.source: device_major
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a special entry and [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) is 3 or 4
segments.translation: 이 엔트리가 특수 엔트리에 대한 것이고 [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)가 3 또는 4인 [경우](bikeshed:=If=)

segments.source: device_minor
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a special entry and [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) is 3 or 4
segments.translation: 이 엔트리가 특수 엔트리에 대한 것이고 [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)가 3 또는 4인 [경우](bikeshed:=If=)

segments.source: special_data
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[*]
[If](bikeshed:=If=) this entry is for a special entry and [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) > 4
segments.translation: 이 엔트리가 특수 엔트리에 대한 것이고 [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)가 4보다 큰 [경우](bikeshed:=If=)

segments.source: Each entry is named according to [entry_name](bikeshed:=meta/entry_name=), which encodes an [entry name](bikeshed:=entry%20name=) as described in [[#archive-model]] and is [decoded](bikeshed:=decode%20an%20entry%20name|=) there.
segments.translation: 각 엔트리의 이름은 [entry_name](bikeshed:=meta/entry_name=)에 따라 정해지며, entry_name은 [[#archive-model]]에 기술된 대로 [엔트리 이름](bikeshed:=entry%20name=)을 인코딩하고 그곳에서 [디코딩](bikeshed:=decode%20an%20entry%20name|=)됩니다.

segments.source: Entry names from ZIP are discussed in [[#entry-names-from-zip]].
A special entry represents a node other than a file or a directory, as determined by [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=):
segments.translation: 특수 엔트리는 [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)에 따라 결정되는, 파일이나 디렉터리가 아닌 노드를 나타냅니다:

segments.source: [special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)
Node
[Tombstone](bikeshed:=Tombstone=), which removes the node at the same path in preceding segments or in the [base](bikeshed:=base=) ([[#segment-merging]])
segments.translation: 선행 세그먼트 또는 [베이스](bikeshed:=base=)에서 같은 경로에 있는 노드를 제거하는 [툼스톤](bikeshed:=Tombstone=) ([[#segment-merging]])

segments.source: [Link node](bikeshed:=Link%20node=), with [link_target](bikeshed:=meta/link_target=) as its target
[Special node](bikeshed:=Special%20node=) of the kind "`fifo`"
[Special node](bikeshed:=Special%20node=) of the kind "`char-device`", with [device_major](bikeshed:=meta/device_major=) and [device_minor](bikeshed:=meta/device_minor=) as its device number
[Special node](bikeshed:=Special%20node=) of the kind "`block-device`", with [device_major](bikeshed:=meta/device_major=) and [device_minor](bikeshed:=meta/device_minor=) as its device number
5 or greater
[Unknown node](bikeshed:=Unknown%20node=), reserved for future versions of this specification
segments.translation: 이 명세의 향후 버전을 위해 예약된 [미지 노드](bikeshed:=Unknown%20node=)

segments.source: [link_target](bikeshed:=meta/link_target=) uses the same encodings as [entry_name](bikeshed:=meta/entry_name=). [special_data](bikeshed:=meta/special_data=) is not interpreted by this version of this specification; its length is determined by the beginning of the next entry in [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=), or [entries_end](bikeshed:=meta/entries_end=) for the last entry.
segments.translation: [link_target](bikeshed:=meta/link_target=)은 [entry_name](bikeshed:=meta/entry_name=)과 같은 인코딩을 사용합니다. [special_data](bikeshed:=meta/special_data=)는 이 버전의 명세에서 해석되지 않으며, 그 길이는 [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=)에 있는 다음 엔트리의 시작 위치로 결정되고, 마지막 엔트리의 경우에는 [entries_end](bikeshed:=meta/entries_end=)로 결정됩니다.

segments.source: Special entries are numbered separately from files, as directories are, so that [file_params](bikeshed:=meta/file_params=) remain directly indexed by entry numbers.
segments.translation: 특수 엔트리는 디렉터리와 마찬가지로 파일과 별도로 번호가 매겨지므로, [file_params](bikeshed:=meta/file_params=)는 계속 엔트리 번호로 직접 인덱싱됩니다.

segments.source: A link target is stored in the entry rather than in the [optional metadata](bikeshed:[[#optional-metadata]]), because it defines the node itself and can't be ignored.
segments.translation: 링크 대상은 노드 자체를 정의하며 무시될 수 없으므로, [선택 메타데이터](bikeshed:[[#optional-metadata]])가 아니라 엔트리에 저장됩니다.

segments.source: Since the metadata block is compressed as a whole, similar targets compress well.
segments.translation: 메타데이터 블록은 전체가 한꺼번에 압축되므로, 비슷한 대상들은 잘 압축됩니다.

segments.source: Unknown kinds are not an [invalid archive](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) failure, so that a decompressor can still extract the rest of an archive using a kind defined in the future.
segments.translation: 미지 종류는 [잘못된 아카이브](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) 실패가 아니므로, 압축 해제기는 향후 정의될 종류를 사용하는 아카이브에서도 나머지 부분을 여전히 추출할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Every special entry can be skipped without knowing its kind, thanks to [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=).
segments.translation: 모든 특수 엔트리는 [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=) 덕분에 그 종류를 알지 못해도 건너뛸 수 있습니다.

segments.source: An unknown node replaces an earlier node at the same path like any other non-directory node ([[#segment-merging]]), so a future kind can't change how segments are merged.
segments.translation: 미지 노드는 디렉터리 노드가 아닌 다른 모든 노드와 마찬가지로 같은 경로에 있는 앞선 노드를 대체하므로([[#segment-merging]]), 향후 정의될 종류가 세그먼트 병합 방식을 바꿀 수 없습니다.

segments.source: This is why tombstones are defined by this version, as the first kind: a decompressor treating a tombstone as an unknown node would keep it in place of the node it was meant to remove.
segments.translation: 이것이 툼스톤을 이 버전에서 첫 번째 종류로 정의하는 이유입니다. 툼스톤을 미지 노드로 취급하는 압축 해제기는 툼스톤이 제거하려던 노드 자리에 툼스톤을 그대로 남겨 두게 됩니다.

segments.source: The [entries](bikeshed:=meta/entries=) array is the only part that has the unspecified number of bytes, which is therefore available as [entries_size](bikeshed:=meta/entries_size=) beforehand.
segments.translation: [엔트리](bikeshed:=meta/entries=) 배열은 바이트 수가 지정되지 않은 유일한 부분이며, 따라서 그 크기를 [entries_size](bikeshed:=meta/entries_size=)로 미리 알 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Any other field can be randomly accessed after reading the initial set of [leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=) fields.
segments.translation: 그 밖의 모든 필드는 처음의 [leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=) 필드들을 읽은 뒤 임의 접근할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: As an exception to the relative offsets above, [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=) are measured from [entries_start](bikeshed:=meta/entries_start=).
segments.translation: 위의 상대 오프셋에 대한 예외로, [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=)는 [entries_start](bikeshed:=meta/entries_start=)로부터 측정합니다.

segments.source: The entry 1 always starts at [entries_start](bikeshed:=meta/entries_start=), so its offset is omitted, and [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=)[|k| - 2] is the offset to the beginning of the entry |k| for each |k| ≥ 2.
segments.translation: 엔트리 1은 항상 [entries_start](bikeshed:=meta/entries_start=)에서 시작하므로 그 오프셋은 생략되며, 각 |k| ≥ 2에 대해 [entry_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/entry_offsets=)[|k| - 2]는 엔트리 |k|의 시작 위치까지의 오프셋입니다.

segments.source: They MUST agree with the actual positions of [entries](bikeshed:=meta/entries=).
segments.translation: 이 값들은 [엔트리](bikeshed:=meta/entries=)의 실제 위치와 일치해야 합니다.

segments.source: [optional_metadata](bikeshed:=meta/optional_metadata=) is described in Optional metadata ([[#optional-metadata]]).
Interpreting an archive

To <dfn export>interpret an archive</dfn> given a [byte sequence](bikeshed:=byte%20sequence=) |input|, an optional passphrase |passphrase| and an optional [base](bikeshed:=base=) |base|, which is an [archive value](bikeshed:=archive%20value=):
segments.translation: [바이트열](bikeshed:=byte%20sequence=) |input|, 선택적인 패스프레이즈 |passphrase|, 그리고 [아카이브 값](bikeshed:=archive%20value=)인 선택적인 [베이스](bikeshed:=base=) |base|가 주어졌을 때 <dfn export>아카이브를 해석</dfn>하려면 다음과 같이 합니다.

segments.source: If |input| starts with [ENCRYPTED_HEADER_MAGIC](bikeshed:=const/ENCRYPTED_HEADER_MAGIC=) or [ENCRYPTED_MIRRORED_HEADER_MAGIC](bikeshed:=const/ENCRYPTED_MIRRORED_HEADER_MAGIC=):
Parse |input| as the encrypted archive structure ([[#encrypted-archive]]) in its entirety.
If it fails to parse, return an [invalid archive](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) failure.
If [header_checksum](bikeshed:=envelope/header_checksum=) is present and doesn't match, return an [invalid archive](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) failure.
segments.translation: [header_checksum](bikeshed:=envelope/header_checksum=)이 있고 일치하지 않으면 [잘못된 아카이브](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) 실패를 반환합니다.

segments.source: If [lg_work_factor](bikeshed:=envelope/lg_work_factor=) exceeds an implementation-defined limit, return a [resource failure](bikeshed:=resource%20failure=).
segments.translation: [lg_work_factor](bikeshed:=envelope/lg_work_factor=)가 구현에서 정의한 한도를 초과하면 [리소스 실패](bikeshed:=resource%20failure=)를 반환합니다.

segments.source: If |passphrase| is not given, or the file key can't be unwrapped from [encrypted_file_key](bikeshed:=envelope/encrypted_file_key=) with |passphrase| as described in [[!AGE]], return a [decryption failure](bikeshed:=decryption%20failure=).
segments.translation: 패스프레이즈 |passphrase|가 주어지지 않았거나, [[!AGE]]에 설명된 대로 |passphrase|로 [encrypted_file_key](bikeshed:=envelope/encrypted_file_key=)에서 파일 키를 언래핑할 수 없으면, [복호화 실패](bikeshed:=decryption%20failure=)를 반환하십시오.

segments.source: Using the unwrapped file key, verify [age_header_mac](bikeshed:=envelope/age_header_mac=) against the reconstructed age header and decrypt the [age payload](bikeshed:=age%20payload=) as described in [[!AGE]].
segments.translation: 풀어낸 파일 키를 사용하여, [[!AGE]]에 설명된 대로 재구성한 age 헤더에 대해 [age_header_mac](bikeshed:=envelope/age_header_mac=)을 검증하고 [age 페이로드](bikeshed:=age%20payload=)를 복호화합니다.

segments.source: If either fails, return an [invalid archive](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) failure.
segments.translation: 둘 중 하나라도 실패하면 [잘못된 아카이브](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) 실패를 반환합니다.

segments.source: Set |input| to the decrypted payload.
It MUST satisfy the additional constraints in [[#encrypted-archive]], or an [invalid archive](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) failure is returned.
segments.translation: 이 페이로드는 [[#encrypted-archive]]의 추가 제약 조건을 충족해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 [잘못된 아카이브](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) 실패를 반환합니다.

segments.source: If |input| parses as the unencrypted archive structure ([[#unencrypted-archive]]) in its entirety, with [data](bikeshed:=block/data=) of every block taken as a [byte sequence](bikeshed:=byte%20sequence=) without parsing, and either the type of any of [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) is [critical](bikeshed:=critical=) and not defined by this specification, or any of [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) is a [shorthand block](bikeshed:=shorthand%20block=) of 32 bytes of [data](bikeshed:=block/data=) whose [registered hash](bikeshed:=registered%20hash=) the decompressor doesn't know ([[#registered-blocks]]), return an [unsupported failure](bikeshed:=unsupported%20failure=).
segments.translation: 모든 블록의 [data](bikeshed:=block/data=)를 파싱하지 않고 [바이트열](bikeshed:=byte%20sequence=)로 취급하여 |input| 전체가 암호화되지 않은 아카이브 구조([[#unencrypted-archive]])로 파싱되고, [블록](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) 중 어느 하나의 타입이 [필수](bikeshed:=critical=)이면서 이 명세에서 정의하지 않은 것이거나, [블록](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) 중 어느 하나가 [data](bikeshed:=block/data=)가 32바이트이고 압축 해제기가 그 [등록 해시](bikeshed:=registered%20hash=)를 알지 못하는 [약칭 블록](bikeshed:=shorthand%20block=)이면([[#registered-blocks]]), [미지원 실패](bikeshed:=unsupported%20failure=)를 반환합니다.

segments.source: Parse |input| as the unencrypted archive structure ([[#unencrypted-archive]]) in its entirety.
segments.translation: |input| 전체를 암호화되지 않은 아카이브 구조([[#unencrypted-archive]])로 파싱합니다.

segments.source: If it fails to parse, return an [invalid archive](bikeshed:=invalid%20archive=) failure.
If |input| is an [overlay archive](bikeshed:=overlay%20archive=) and |base| is not given, return a [base failure](bikeshed:=base%20failure=).

If |input| is a [standalone archive](bikeshed:=standalone%20archive=), set |base| to an [archive value](bikeshed:=archive%20value=) whose [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=) is a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=) with an empty map as [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=) and null as [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=), and whose [extra](bikeshed:=archive%20value/extra=) is an empty map.
segments.translation: |input|이 [독립 아카이브](bikeshed:=standalone%20archive=)이면, 베이스 |base|를 [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=)가 [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)으로 빈 맵을, [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)로 null을 가지는 [디렉터리 노드](bikeshed:=directory%20node=)이고 [extra](bikeshed:=archive%20value/extra=)가 빈 맵인 [아카이브 값](bikeshed:=archive%20value=)으로 설정하십시오.

segments.source: If [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) contain no [metadata block](bikeshed:[[#metadata-block]]):

Let |content| be the concatenation of the [file contents](bikeshed:=file%20contents=) of all [leaf blocks](bikeshed:=leaf%20blocks=) in [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=), in the order of appearance, each for every output index from 0 in order (all outputs of a formula block, and the only one of a data block).
segments.translation: |content|를 [블록](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=)에 있는 모든 [리프 블록](bikeshed:=leaf%20blocks=)의 [파일 내용](bikeshed:=file%20contents=)을 나타나는 순서대로, 각각 0부터 차례로 모든 출력 인덱스에 대해(공식 블록은 모든 출력, 데이터 블록은 유일한 출력) 연결한 것으로 둡니다.

segments.source: Return an [archive value](bikeshed:=archive%20value=) whose [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=) is a [file node](bikeshed:=file%20node=) with |content| as [content](bikeshed:=file%20node/content=), null as [link group](bikeshed:=file%20node/link%20group=) and null as [extra](bikeshed:=file%20node/extra=), and whose [extra](bikeshed:=archive%20value/extra=) is an empty map.
segments.translation: [루트](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=)가 |content|를 [내용](bikeshed:=file%20node/content=)으로, null을 [링크 그룹](bikeshed:=file%20node/link%20group=)으로, null을 [extra](bikeshed:=file%20node/extra=)로 갖는 [파일 노드](bikeshed:=file%20node=)이고, [extra](bikeshed:=archive%20value/extra=)가 빈 맵인 [아카이브 값](bikeshed:=archive%20value=)을 반환합니다.

segments.source: If the [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=) of |base| is a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=), let |root| be a copy of it.
Otherwise let |root| be a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=) with an empty map as [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=) and null as [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=).
segments.translation: 그렇지 않으면 |root|를 빈 맵을 [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)으로, null을 [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)로 갖는 [디렉터리 노드](bikeshed:=directory%20node=)로 둡니다.

segments.source: Let |extra| be a copy of the [extra](bikeshed:=archive%20value/extra=) of |base|.
For each [segment](bikeshed:=segment=) |segment| in [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=), in the order of appearance:
segments.translation: [블록](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) 안의 각 [세그먼트](bikeshed:=segment=) |segment|에 대해, 나타나는 순서대로 다음을 수행합니다:

segments.source: Let |segment root| be the result of [interpreting](bikeshed:=interpret%20a%20segment|=) |segment|.
[Merge](bikeshed:=Merge%20directory%20nodes|=) |segment root| into |root|.
For each key |k| and value |v| in the top-level map of the segment's [optional metadata](bikeshed:[[#optional-metadata]]) other than `entry-extras`, set |extra|[|k|] to |v|.
segments.translation: 세그먼트의 [선택적 메타데이터](bikeshed:[[#optional-metadata]])의 최상위 맵에 있는 `entry-extras` 이외의 각 키 |k|와 값 |v|에 대해, |extra|[|k|]를 |v|로 설정합니다.

segments.source: Return an [archive value](bikeshed:=archive%20value=) with |root| as [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=) and |extra| as [extra](bikeshed:=archive%20value/extra=).

The <dfn>archive base</dfn> is |base| after the step 5, and the <dfn>preceding result</dfn> of a [segment](bikeshed:=segment=) is |root| just before the segment is interpreted in the step 9, or the [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=) of the archive base for an archive without a metadata block.
segments.translation: <dfn>아카이브 베이스</dfn>는 5단계 이후의 |base|이며, [세그먼트](bikeshed:=segment=)의 <dfn>선행 결과</dfn>는 9단계에서 해당 세그먼트가 해석되기 직전의 |root|이거나, 메타데이터 블록이 없는 아카이브의 경우 아카이브 베이스의 [root](bikeshed:=archive%20value/root=)입니다.

segments.source: They are what [external imports](bikeshed:=external%20imports=) and [internal imports](bikeshed:=internal%20imports=) respectively refer to ([[#import-resolution]]).
segments.translation: 이들은 각각 [외부 임포트](bikeshed:=external%20imports=)와 [내부 임포트](bikeshed:=internal%20imports=)가 참조하는 대상입니다([[#import-resolution]]).

segments.source: A given |base| doesn't affect the interpretation of a [standalone archive](bikeshed:=standalone%20archive=).
segments.translation: 주어진 베이스 |base|는 [독립 아카이브](bikeshed:=standalone%20archive=)의 해석에 영향을 주지 않습니다.

segments.source: The preceding result of the first segment of an [overlay archive](bikeshed:=overlay%20archive=) is its base, so an internal import can also read a file of the base, as long as no preceding segment has replaced or removed it.
segments.translation: [오버레이 아카이브](bikeshed:=overlay%20archive=)의 첫 번째 세그먼트의 선행 결과는 그 베이스이므로, 선행 세그먼트가 베이스의 파일을 대체하거나 제거하지 않은 한 내부 임포트도 그 파일을 읽을 수 있습니다.

segments.source: An external import reads the base as given, even after a preceding segment has replaced the file.
segments.translation: 외부 임포트는 선행 세그먼트가 파일을 대체한 이후에도 주어진 그대로의 베이스를 읽습니다.

segments.source: An overlay archive without a metadata block replaces its base with a single file, e.g. to patch a single file given as the base.
segments.translation: 메타데이터 블록이 없는 오버레이 아카이브는 그 베이스를 단일 파일로 대체하며, 예를 들어 베이스로 주어진 단일 파일을 패치하는 데 사용됩니다.

segments.source: The input to this algorithm is exactly the archive, from the first byte of [header_magic](bikeshed:=archive/header_magic=) to the last byte of [footer_size_copy](bikeshed:=archive/footer_size_copy=).
segments.translation: 이 알고리즘의 입력은 정확히 [header_magic](bikeshed:=archive/header_magic=)의 첫 번째 바이트부터 [footer_size_copy](bikeshed:=archive/footer_size_copy=)의 마지막 바이트까지의 아카이브입니다.

segments.source: A file may contain an archive with leading or trailing bytes, which a decompressor removes by [locating the archive](bikeshed:=locate%20an%20archive|=) ([[#locating-an-archive]]).
segments.translation: 파일은 앞쪽 또는 뒤쪽 바이트가 있는 아카이브를 포함할 수 있으며, 압축 해제기는 [아카이브 위치 찾기](bikeshed:=locate%20an%20archive|=)([[#locating-an-archive]])를 통해 이를 제거합니다.

segments.source: Since every [content block](bikeshed:=content%20block=) has to be described by a subsequent metadata block ([[#content-blocks]]), an archive with a metadata block can't have any content block after the last metadata block. [previous_metadata_offset](bikeshed:=meta/previous_metadata_offset=) and [metadata_backward_offset](bikeshed:=archive/metadata_backward_offset=) MUST point to the metadata blocks found by parsing [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=) as described in [[#metadata-block]] and [[#unencrypted-archive]], so that a decompressor can find each [segment](bikeshed:=segment=) either by scanning blocks forward or by following offsets backward.
segments.translation: 모든 [콘텐츠 블록](bikeshed:=content%20block=)은 뒤따르는 메타데이터 블록에 의해 기술되어야 하므로([[#content-blocks]]), 메타데이터 블록이 있는 아카이브는 마지막 메타데이터 블록 뒤에 어떤 콘텐츠 블록도 가질 수 없습니다. 압축 해제기가 블록을 앞쪽으로 스캔하거나 오프셋을 뒤쪽으로 따라가는 방식 중 어느 쪽으로든 각 [세그먼트](bikeshed:=segment=)를 찾을 수 있도록, [previous_metadata_offset](bikeshed:=meta/previous_metadata_offset=)와 [metadata_backward_offset](bikeshed:=archive/metadata_backward_offset=)는 [[#metadata-block]] 및 [[#unencrypted-archive]]에 기술된 대로 [blocks](bikeshed:=archive/blocks=)를 파싱하여 찾은 메타데이터 블록을 가리켜야 합니다.

segments.source: Interpreting a segment
To <dfn>interpret a segment</dfn> |segment| whose metadata block is |metadata block|:
segments.translation: 메타데이터 블록이 |metadata block|인 |segment|를 <dfn>세그먼트 해석</dfn>하려면 다음을 수행합니다:

segments.source: Let |meta| be the [decoded data](bikeshed:=decoded%20data=) of |metadata block|, parsed as its internal structure ([[#metadata-block]]).
segments.translation: |meta|를 메타데이터 블록 |metadata block|의 [디코딩된 데이터](bikeshed:=decoded%20data=)를 그 내부 구조([[#metadata-block]])로 파싱한 것으로 둡니다.

segments.source: Let |d| be [num_directories](bikeshed:=meta/num_directories=), |f| be [num_directories](bikeshed:=meta/num_directories=) + [num_files](bikeshed:=meta/num_files=) and |n| be [num_directories](bikeshed:=meta/num_directories=) + [num_files](bikeshed:=meta/num_files=) + [num_specials](bikeshed:=meta/num_specials=) of |meta|.

Let |nodes| be a [list](bikeshed:=list=) containing a single [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=) with an empty map as [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=) and the [entry extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=) for the entry 0 as [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=).
segments.translation: |nodes|를 빈 맵을 [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)으로, 엔트리 0에 대한 [엔트리 extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=)를 [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)로 하는 단일 [디렉터리 노드](bikeshed:=directory%20node=)를 포함하는 [리스트](bikeshed:=list=)라고 합니다.

segments.source: For each |k| in [1, |n|]:
Let |entry| be |meta|.[entries](bikeshed:=meta/entries=)[|k| - 1].
Let |name| be the result of [decoding](bikeshed:=decode%20an%20entry%20name|=) |entry|.[entry_name](bikeshed:=meta/entry_name=).
Let |parent| be 0 if |k| = 1, or |meta|.[entry_parents](bikeshed:=meta/entry_parents=)[|k| - 2] otherwise.
If |k| ≤ |d|, let |node| be a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=) with an empty map as [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=).
Otherwise, if |k| ≤ |f|:
Let |param| be |meta|.[file_params](bikeshed:=meta/file_params=)[|k| - |d| - 1].
Let |block| be the block at the relative offset |param|.[file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) - |param|.[file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) % 2 from |metadata block|.
segments.translation: |block|을 메타데이터 블록 |metadata block|으로부터 상대 오프셋 |param|.[file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) - |param|.[file_offset](bikeshed:=meta/file_offset=) % 2에 있는 블록으로 둡니다.

segments.source: It MUST be a [leaf block](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=) in |segment|.
segments.translation: 이 블록은 세그먼트 |segment| 안의 [리프 블록](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=)이어야 합니다.

segments.source: If |param|.[file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=) is zero, |block| MUST NOT use a dictionary.
Otherwise, |block| MUST use the dictionary block at |meta|.[dictionary_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/dictionary_offsets=)[|param|.[file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=) - 1].
segments.translation: 그렇지 않으면, |block|은 |meta|.[dictionary_offsets](bikeshed:=meta/dictionary_offsets=)[|param|.[file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=) - 1]에 있는 사전 블록을 사용해야 합니다.

segments.source: Let |content| be the [file content](bikeshed:=file%20content=) of |block| for the [file output index](bikeshed:=file%20output%20index=) of |param|.
segments.translation: |param|의 [파일 출력 인덱스](bikeshed:=file%20output%20index=)에 대한 블록 |block|의 [파일 콘텐츠](bikeshed:=file%20content=)를 |content|라 합니다.

segments.source: Its length MUST be |entry|.[original_size](bikeshed:=meta/original_size=).
Let |node| be a [file node](bikeshed:=file%20node=) with |content| as [content](bikeshed:=file%20node/content=) and null as [link group](bikeshed:=file%20node/link%20group=).

If the [entry extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=) for the entry |k| has `link-group` with a value |g|, set |node|.[link group](bikeshed:=file%20node/link%20group=) to a pair of |segment| and |g| if |g| ≥ 0, or to |g| otherwise.
segments.translation: 엔트리 |k|에 대한 [엔트리 extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=)에 값 |g|를 가진 `link-group`이 있으면, |g| ≥ 0인 경우 |node|.[링크 그룹](bikeshed:=file%20node/link%20group=)을 |segment|와 |g|의 쌍으로, 그렇지 않은 경우 |g|로 설정하십시오.

segments.source: Otherwise, if |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) is 0, let |node| be a [tombstone](bikeshed:=tombstone=).
The [entry extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=) for the entry |k| MUST be null.
segments.translation: 엔트리 |k|에 대한 [엔트리 추가 정보](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=)는 null이어야 합니다.

segments.source: Otherwise, if |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) is 1:
Let |target| be the result of [decoding](bikeshed:=decode%20a%20link%20target|=) |entry|.[link_target](bikeshed:=meta/link_target=).
Let |node| be a [link node](bikeshed:=link%20node=) with |target| as [target](bikeshed:=link%20node/target=).

Otherwise, if |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) is 2, let |node| be a [special node](bikeshed:=special%20node=) with "`fifo`" as [kind](bikeshed:=special%20node/kind=) and null as [device](bikeshed:=special%20node/device=).
segments.translation: 그렇지 않고 엔트리 |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)가 2이면, |node|를 [종류](bikeshed:=special%20node/kind=)가 "`fifo`"이고 [장치](bikeshed:=special%20node/device=)가 null인 [특수 노드](bikeshed:=special%20node=)라 합니다.

segments.source: Otherwise, if |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) is 3 or 4, let |node| be a [special node](bikeshed:=special%20node=) with "`char-device`" or "`block-device`" respectively as [kind](bikeshed:=special%20node/kind=) and (|entry|.[device_major](bikeshed:=meta/device_major=), |entry|.[device_minor](bikeshed:=meta/device_minor=)) as [device](bikeshed:=special%20node/device=).
segments.translation: 그렇지 않고 엔트리 |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=)가 3 또는 4이면, |node|를 [종류](bikeshed:=special%20node/kind=)가 각각 "`char-device`" 또는 "`block-device`"이고 [장치](bikeshed:=special%20node/device=)가 (|entry|.[device_major](bikeshed:=meta/device_major=), |entry|.[device_minor](bikeshed:=meta/device_minor=))인 [특수 노드](bikeshed:=special%20node=)라 합니다.

segments.source: Otherwise, let |node| be an [unknown node](bikeshed:=unknown%20node=) with |entry|.[special_kind](bikeshed:=meta/special_kind=) as [kind](bikeshed:=unknown%20node/kind=) and |entry|.[special_data](bikeshed:=meta/special_data=) as [data](bikeshed:=unknown%20node/data=).
If |node| is not a [tombstone](bikeshed:=tombstone=), set the extra of |node| to the [entry extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=) for the entry |k|.
segments.translation: |node|가 [툼스톤](bikeshed:=tombstone=)이 아니면, |node|의 extra를 엔트리 |k|에 대한 [엔트리 extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=)로 설정하십시오.

segments.source: Let |children| be the [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=) of |nodes|[|parent|]. |children|[|name|] MUST NOT [exist](bikeshed:=map/exist=).
Set |children|[|name|] to |node|.
[Append](bikeshed:=list/Append=) |node| to |nodes|.
Return |nodes|[0].
Since every |parent| is less than |k| and at most |d| by [[#metadata-block]], |nodes|[|parent|] is always a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=) already in |nodes|.
segments.translation: [[#metadata-block]]에 따라 모든 |parent|는 |k|보다 작고 |d| 이하이므로, |nodes|[|parent|]는 항상 |nodes|에 이미 있는 [디렉터리 노드](bikeshed:=directory%20node=)입니다.

segments.source: The entry extra for the entry |k| is the element at the 0-based index |k| of `entry-extras` in the segment's optional metadata, where the index 0 corresponds to the root directory, or null if `entry-extras` or such element doesn't exist. `entry-extras` MUST NOT have more elements than the entries including the root directory, i.e. [num_directories](bikeshed:=meta/num_directories=) + [num_files](bikeshed:=meta/num_files=) + [num_specials](bikeshed:=meta/num_specials=) + 1.
segments.translation: 엔트리 |k|에 대한 엔트리 추가 정보는 세그먼트의 선택적 메타데이터에 있는 `entry-extras`의 0부터 시작하는 인덱스 |k|에 있는 요소이며, 인덱스 0은 루트 디렉터리에 해당합니다. `entry-extras` 또는 해당 요소가 존재하지 않으면 null입니다. `entry-extras`는 루트 디렉터리를 포함한 엔트리 수, 즉 [num_directories](bikeshed:=meta/num_directories=) + [num_files](bikeshed:=meta/num_files=) + [num_specials](bikeshed:=meta/num_specials=) + 1보다 많은 요소를 가져서는 안 됩니다.

segments.source: Merging segments
To <dfn>merge directory nodes</dfn> |later| into |earlier|:
For each |name| → |node| of |later|.[children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=):
Let |existing| be |earlier|.[children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)[|name|], or null if it doesn't [exist](bikeshed:=map/exist=).
If |node| is a [tombstone](bikeshed:=tombstone=), [remove](bikeshed:=map/remove=) |earlier|.[children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)[|name|] if it [exists](bikeshed:=map/exists=).
Otherwise, if |node| is a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=):

If |existing| is not a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=), set |existing| to a [directory node](bikeshed:=directory%20node=) with an empty map as [children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=) and null as [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=), and set |earlier|.[children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)[|name|] to |existing|.
segments.translation: |existing|이 [디렉터리 노드](bikeshed:=directory%20node=)가 아니면, |existing|을 빈 맵을 [자식](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)으로, null을 [추가 정보](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)로 갖는 [디렉터리 노드](bikeshed:=directory%20node=)로 설정하고, |earlier|.[자식](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)[|name|]을 |existing|으로 설정합니다.

segments.source: [Merge](bikeshed:=Merge%20directory%20nodes|=) |node| into |existing|.
Otherwise, set |earlier|.[children](bikeshed:=directory%20node/children=)[|name|] to |node|.
If |later|.[extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=) is not null, set |earlier|.[extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=) to it.
segments.translation: |later|.[추가 정보](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)가 null이 아니면, |earlier|.[추가 정보](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)를 그것으로 설정합니다.

segments.source: As a result, a directory appearing in multiple segments has the union of their children, while any other node, or a directory replaced by a node of the different kind, is replaced as a whole with its descendants.
segments.translation: 결과적으로 여러 세그먼트에 나타나는 디렉터리는 그 자식들의 합집합을 가지며, 그 밖의 노드나 다른 종류의 노드로 대체된 디렉터리는 그 자손과 함께 통째로 대체됩니다.

segments.source: In particular, a directory replaced by a [link node](bikeshed:=link%20node=) loses all its descendants, so no node is a descendant of a [link node](bikeshed:=link%20node=) in the result.
segments.translation: 특히 [링크 노드](bikeshed:=link%20node=)로 대체된 디렉터리는 모든 자손을 잃으므로, 결과에서 어떤 노드도 [링크 노드](bikeshed:=link%20node=)의 자손이 아닙니다.

segments.source: A [tombstone](bikeshed:=tombstone=) removes the node at its path along with its descendants, and does nothing if there is no such node.
segments.translation: [툼스톤](bikeshed:=tombstone=)은 자신의 경로에 있는 노드를 그 자손과 함께 제거하며, 그러한 노드가 없으면 아무것도 하지 않습니다.

segments.source: A tombstone is never kept in the result, even under a directory that didn't exist before.
segments.translation: 툼스톤은 이전에 존재하지 않던 디렉터리 아래에 있더라도 결과에 결코 남지 않습니다.

segments.source: A directory with a null [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=) in a later segment keeps the existing [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=), which can instead be replaced with an empty map `{}`.
segments.translation: 이후 세그먼트에서 [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)가 null인 디렉터리는 기존 [extra](bikeshed:=directory%20node/extra=)를 유지하며, 대신 빈 맵 `{}`으로 대체할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Directories necessarily reappear in later segments to hold new files under them, which is why a directory is merged with an existing one rather than replacing it.
segments.translation: 디렉터리는 그 아래에 새 파일을 담기 위해 이후 세그먼트에 필연적으로 다시 나타나며, 이 때문에 디렉터리는 기존 디렉터리를 대체하지 않고 기존 디렉터리와 병합됩니다.

segments.source: For the same reason, a reappearing directory doesn't have to repeat its [entry extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=).
segments.translation: 같은 이유로, 다시 나타나는 디렉터리는 자신의 [엔트리 extra](bikeshed:=entry%20extra=)를 반복할 필요가 없습니다.

segments.source: A directory whose children change entirely, e.g. from |A| to |B|, keeps its node and gets tombstones for the names in |A| but not in |B|, while the names in |B| replace or add nodes as usual.
segments.translation: 예를 들어 |A|에서 |B|로 자식이 완전히 바뀌는 디렉터리는 자신의 노드를 유지하고 |A|에는 있지만 |B|에는 없는 이름에 대해 툼스톤을 받으며, |B|의 이름은 평소와 같이 노드를 대체하거나 추가합니다.

segments.source: A tombstone on a directory states that the directory itself is absent from the result, and a single tombstone removes a whole subtree.
segments.translation: 디렉터리에 대한 툼스톤은 그 디렉터리 자체가 결과에 없음을 나타내며, 하나의 툼스톤이 하위 트리 전체를 제거합니다.

segments.source: So replacing the entire base of an [overlay archive](bikeshed:=overlay%20archive=) needs a tombstone for each name only in the base at the topmost level where the base and the new tree differ.
segments.translation: 따라서 [오버레이 아카이브](bikeshed:=overlay%20archive=)의 베이스 전체를 대체하려면 베이스와 새 트리가 달라지는 최상위 수준에서 베이스에만 있는 각 이름에 대해 툼스톤이 필요합니다.

segments.source: Stored data
Data block
Blocks 20<sub>16</sub> through 37<sub>16</sub> and 40<sub>16</sub> through 4B<sub>16</sub> are **data blocks**.
A data block is a **compressed block** if its [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) is not None, and an **uncompressed block** otherwise.
segments.translation: 데이터 블록은 [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=)가 None이 아니면 **압축된 블록**이고, 그렇지 않으면 **압축되지 않은 블록**입니다.

segments.source: The [type](bikeshed:=block/type=) of a data block is
in binary ([[#block-types]]) for a [leaf block](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=), and
for a [non-leaf block](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20block=), where:

|kk| determines [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) and whether a dictionary is used (<dfn>has_dictionary</dfn>): 0 for None without dictionary, 1 for [Zstandard](bikeshed:[[#zstandard-compression-method]]) without dictionary, and 2 for [Zstandard](bikeshed:[[#zstandard-compression-method]]) with dictionary. 3 is reserved for future compression methods.
segments.translation: |kk|는 [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=)와 사전 사용 여부(<dfn>has_dictionary</dfn>)를 결정합니다: 0은 사전 없는 None, 1은 사전 없는 [Zstandard](bikeshed:[[#zstandard-compression-method]]), 2는 사전을 사용하는 [Zstandard](bikeshed:[[#zstandard-compression-method]])입니다. 3은 향후 압축 방식을 위해 예약되어 있습니다.

segments.source: |c| determines [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=): None if 0, and [XXH64](bikeshed:[[#xxh64-checksum-method]]) if 1.
A non-leaf data block always uses [XXH64](bikeshed:[[#xxh64-checksum-method]]) ([[#checksums]]).
Its data consists of the following:
Name
Type
Conditions
dictionary_index
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) [has_dictionary](bikeshed:=dblock/has_dictionary=)
compressed_data
[compressed_data](bikeshed:=block/compressed_data=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) is not None
uncompressed_data
[uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=block/uncompressed_data=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) is None
If a dictionary is in use, its 0-based index is specified as [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=dblock/dictionary_index=).
segments.translation: 사전을 사용하는 경우, 그 0부터 시작하는 인덱스는 [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=dblock/dictionary_index=)로 지정됩니다.

segments.source: For a leaf data block, the metadata block also gives the dictionary as [file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=), which is available before reading the block; for a non-leaf data block, [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=dblock/dictionary_index=) is the only reference to the dictionary. [compressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/compressed_data=) and [uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/uncompressed_data=) use the shared external structure ([[#shared-external-structure]]) with [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) and [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=) determined as above. [uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/uncompressed_data=) represents a raw, uninterpreted byte sequence.
segments.translation: 리프 데이터 블록의 경우 메타데이터 블록도 사전을 [file_dictionary](bikeshed:=meta/file_dictionary=)로 제공하며, 이는 블록을 읽기 전에 사용할 수 있습니다. 비리프 데이터 블록의 경우 [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=dblock/dictionary_index=)가 사전에 대한 유일한 참조입니다. [compressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/compressed_data=)와 [uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/uncompressed_data=)는 위와 같이 결정된 [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) 및 [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=)와 함께 공유 외부 구조([[#shared-external-structure]])를 사용합니다. [uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/uncompressed_data=)는 해석되지 않은 원시 바이트열을 나타냅니다.

segments.source: A compressed block is a single unit of decompression: reading any part of its content requires decompressing it from the beginning.
segments.translation: 압축된 블록은 하나의 압축 해제 단위입니다. 즉, 그 내용의 어느 부분을 읽든 처음부터 압축을 해제해야 합니다.

segments.source: Content larger than a desired unit of random access is split into multiple blocks:
segments.translation: 원하는 임의 접근 단위보다 큰 내용은 여러 블록으로 분할됩니다.

segments.source: In general, a file is represented by a [formula block](bikeshed:[[#formula-block]]) concatenating multiple non-leaf blocks, which typically form a single [parcel](bikeshed:=parcel=) together.
segments.translation: 일반적으로 파일은 여러 비리프 블록을 연결하는 [공식 블록](bikeshed:[[#formula-block]])으로 표현되며, 이 비리프 블록들은 보통 함께 하나의 [파셀](bikeshed:=parcel=)을 이룹니다.

segments.source: The formula block then acts as an index for random access within the parcel.
segments.translation: 그러면 공식 블록은 파셀 내 임의 접근을 위한 인덱스 역할을 합니다.

segments.source: In an archive without a metadata block ([[#unencrypted-archive]]), the file is simply represented by multiple leaf blocks.
segments.translation: 메타데이터 블록이 없는 아카이브([[#unencrypted-archive]])에서는 파일이 단순히 여러 리프 블록으로 표현됩니다.

segments.source: Dictionary block
Blocks 50<sub>16</sub> through 57<sub>16</sub> are **dictionary blocks**, whose [type](bikeshed:=block/type=) is
in binary ([[#block-types]]).

Their data is [checksummed Zstandard data](bikeshed:=checksummed%20Zstandard%20data=) ([[#shared-external-structure]]), except that block 50<sub>16</sub> is a [shorthand block](bikeshed:=shorthand%20block=) for a [registered dictionary](bikeshed:=registered%20dictionary=) ([[#registered-blocks]]).
segments.translation: 그 데이터는 [체크섬이 있는 Zstandard 데이터](bikeshed:=checksummed%20Zstandard%20data=)([[#shared-external-structure]])이지만, 블록 50<sub>16</sub>은 [등록 사전](bikeshed:=registered%20dictionary=)에 대한 [약칭 블록](bikeshed:=shorthand%20block=)([[#registered-blocks]])이라는 점이 예외입니다.

segments.source: |t| determines whether the dictionary has entropy tables (<dfn>has_entropy_tables</dfn>): false if 0, and true if 1.
segments.translation: |t|는 사전이 엔트로피 테이블을 가지는지 여부(<dfn>has_entropy_tables</dfn>)를 결정합니다. 0이면 false이고, 1이면 true입니다.

segments.source: The internal structure after decompression is as follows:
segments.translation: 압축 해제 후의 내부 구조는 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: Name
Type
Conditions
entropy_tables
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[*]
[If](bikeshed:=If=) [has_entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/has_entropy_tables=)
repeat_offsets
[u32le](bikeshed:=u32le=)[3]
[If](bikeshed:=If=) [has_entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/has_entropy_tables=)
content
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[*]

The decoded data of a dictionary block is a [dictionary](bikeshed:=dictionary=) for blocks using it, and corresponds to a Zstandard dictionary ([[!RFC8878]], Section 5) without `Magic_Number` and `Dictionary_ID`:
segments.translation: 사전 블록의 디코딩된 데이터는 그것을 사용하는 블록들을 위한 [사전](bikeshed:=dictionary=)이며, `Magic_Number`와 `Dictionary_ID`가 없는 Zstandard 사전([[!RFC8878]], 5절)에 해당합니다.

segments.source: If [has_entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/has_entropy_tables=) is true, [entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/entropy_tables=) is the `Entropy_Tables` structure, whose length is determined by parsing it, and [repeat_offsets](bikeshed:=dict/repeat_offsets=) are the three `Repeat_Offsets` in order.
segments.translation: [has_entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/has_entropy_tables=)가 true이면, [entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/entropy_tables=)는 `Entropy_Tables` 구조이며 그 길이는 이를 파싱하여 결정되고, [repeat_offsets](bikeshed:=dict/repeat_offsets=)는 순서대로 세 개의 `Repeat_Offsets`입니다.

segments.source: Each repeat offset MUST be in [1, length of [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=)].
segments.translation: 각 반복 오프셋은 [1, [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=)의 길이] 범위 안에 있어야 합니다.

segments.source: Otherwise, it is a raw content dictionary: the entropy tables start empty and the repeat offsets start at their initial values (1, 4, 8), even when [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=) begins with the dictionary `Magic_Number`.
segments.translation: 그렇지 않으면 원시 내용 사전입니다. 즉, [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=)가 사전 `Magic_Number`로 시작하더라도 엔트로피 테이블은 빈 상태로 시작하고 반복 오프셋은 초깃값(1, 4, 8)으로 시작합니다.

segments.source: In both cases, [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=) is the `Content` of the dictionary, which is the only part of the dictionary that sequences can reference as preceding data. [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=) MUST be at least 8 bytes long.
segments.translation: 두 경우 모두 [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=)는 사전의 `Content`이며, 이는 시퀀스가 선행 데이터로 참조할 수 있는 사전의 유일한 부분입니다. [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=)는 길이가 최소 8바이트여야 합니다.

segments.source: `Magic_Number` and `Dictionary_ID` are omitted because they are only meaningful for Zstandard frames and the framing is done by this format.
segments.translation: `Magic_Number`와 `Dictionary_ID`는 Zstandard 프레임에서만 의미가 있고 프레이밍은 이 형식이 수행하므로 생략됩니다.

segments.source: An implementation using libzstd can prepend them (with an arbitrary nonzero `Dictionary_ID`) to load a dictionary with entropy tables.
segments.translation: libzstd를 사용하는 구현은 엔트로피 테이블이 있는 사전을 로드하기 위해 (임의의 0이 아닌 `Dictionary_ID`와 함께) 이들을 앞에 덧붙일 수 있습니다.

segments.source: In that case it has to make sure that no sequence references the prepended bytes or [entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/entropy_tables=), which some decompression paths of libzstd don't check.
segments.translation: 그 경우 구현은 어떤 시퀀스도 앞에 덧붙인 바이트나 [entropy_tables](bikeshed:=dict/entropy_tables=)를 참조하지 않도록 보장해야 하는데, libzstd의 일부 압축 해제 경로는 이를 검사하지 않기 때문입니다.

segments.source: Entropy tables can be trained independently of the content (e.g. `ZDICT_finalizeDictionary`) and mainly benefit small blocks: in measurements with per-file blocks of 1–20 KB files, they reduced the size by 0.4–26%, while the benefit vanished for blocks of 64 KB or more.
segments.translation: 엔트로피 테이블은 내용과 독립적으로 학습될 수 있으며(예: `ZDICT_finalizeDictionary`) 주로 작은 블록에 이점이 있습니다. 1–20 KB 파일의 파일별 블록으로 측정한 결과 크기가 0.4–26% 줄었지만, 64 KB 이상의 블록에서는 이점이 사라졌습니다.

segments.source: Fast strategies of libzstd (e.g. levels 1–3 of 1.5.7) reuse the dictionary's entropy tables for every block even when the block's own tables would be smaller.
segments.translation: libzstd의 빠른 전략(예: 1.5.7의 레벨 1–3)은 블록 자체의 테이블이 더 작은 경우에도 모든 블록에 사전의 엔트로피 테이블을 재사용합니다.

segments.source: When the repeat offsets of the dictionary are the initial values, a compressor can avoid this by also compressing a block with the same [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=) as a raw content dictionary and choosing the smaller result, since a block compressed that way never refers to the entropy tables of the dictionary.
segments.translation: 사전의 반복 오프셋이 초기값인 경우, 압축기는 같은 [content](bikeshed:=dict/content=)를 원시 내용 사전으로 사용하여 블록을 한 번 더 압축하고 더 작은 결과를 선택함으로써 이를 피할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 압축된 블록은 사전의 엔트로피 테이블을 결코 참조하지 않기 때문입니다.

segments.source: Block contents

The <dfn>decoded data</dfn> of a block using the shared external structure ([[#shared-external-structure]]), given its [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) and [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=), is determined as follows:
segments.translation: 공유 외부 구조([[#shared-external-structure]])를 사용하는 블록의 <dfn>디코딩된 데이터</dfn>는 그 [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=)와 [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=)가 주어졌을 때 다음과 같이 결정됩니다.

segments.source: If [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) is None, it is [data](bikeshed:=udata/data=).

If [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=) is [Zstandard](bikeshed:[[#zstandard-compression-method]]), it is the result of decompressing [data](bikeshed:=cdata/data=) as described there, with [compression_params](bikeshed:=cdata/compression_params=) and the [dictionary](bikeshed:=dictionary=) given by the dictionary block in use ([[#dictionary-block]]), if any.
segments.translation: [compression_method](bikeshed:=compression_method=)가 [Zstandard](bikeshed:[[#zstandard-compression-method]])이면, 거기에 설명된 대로 [compression_params](bikeshed:=cdata/compression_params=)와, 사용 중인 사전 블록([[#dictionary-block]])이 있는 경우 그 사전 블록이 제공하는 [사전](bikeshed:=dictionary=)을 사용하여 [data](bikeshed:=cdata/data=)를 압축 해제한 결과입니다.

segments.source: The result MUST have exactly [original_size](bikeshed:=cdata/original_size=) bytes.
If [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=) is not None, the checksum MUST be equal to the checksum of the decoded data computed by the [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=).
segments.translation: [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=)가 None이 아니면, 체크섬은 [checksum_method](bikeshed:=checksum_method=)로 계산한 디코딩된 데이터의 체크섬과 같아야 합니다.

segments.source: The <dfn>stored content</dfn> of a [data block](bikeshed:[[#data-block]]), whether a [leaf block](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=) or not, is the [decoded data](bikeshed:=decoded%20data=) of its [compressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/compressed_data=) or [uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/uncompressed_data=).
segments.translation: [데이터 블록](bikeshed:[[#data-block]])의 <dfn>저장된 내용</dfn>은 [리프 블록](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=)인지 여부와 관계없이 그 [compressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/compressed_data=) 또는 [uncompressed_data](bikeshed:=dblock/uncompressed_data=)의 [디코딩된 데이터](bikeshed:=decoded%20data=)입니다.

segments.source: The stored content of a [non-leaf item](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20item=) is the stored content of the non-leaf data block supplying it, or the [imported content](bikeshed:=imported%20content=) of the [import](bikeshed:=import/import=) supplying it ([[#import-resolution]]).
segments.translation: [비리프 항목](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20item=)의 저장된 내용은 그것을 제공하는 비리프 데이터 블록의 저장된 내용이거나, 그것을 제공하는 [임포트](bikeshed:=import/import=)의 [임포트된 내용](bikeshed:=imported%20content=)입니다([[#import-resolution]]).

segments.source: A data block using a dictionary uses the dictionary block at [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=dblock/dictionary_index=) within the [segment](bikeshed:=segment=).
segments.translation: 사전을 사용하는 데이터 블록은 [세그먼트](bikeshed:=segment=) 내 [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=dblock/dictionary_index=) 위치의 사전 블록을 사용합니다.

segments.source: The <dfn>file content</dfn> of a [leaf block](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=) for an output index |i| is:
segments.translation: 출력 인덱스 |i|에 대한 [리프 블록](bikeshed:=leaf%20block=)의 <dfn>파일 내용</dfn>은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: Its [stored content](bikeshed:=stored%20content=), if it is a data block. |i| MUST be 0.

The output at the index |i| of [evaluating](bikeshed:=evaluate%20a%20formula%20block|=) it, if it is a [formula block](bikeshed:[[#formula-block]]). |i| MUST be less than its [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=).
segments.translation: [공식 블록](bikeshed:[[#formula-block]])이면 그것을 [평가](bikeshed:=evaluate%20a%20formula%20block|=)한 결과의 인덱스 |i|에 있는 출력입니다. |i|는 그 [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=)보다 작아야 합니다.

segments.source: Formulas
Formula block
Blocks 70<sub>16</sub> through 77<sub>16</sub> are **formula blocks**, whose [type](bikeshed:=block/type=) is
in binary ([[#block-types]]).
|d| determines whether a dictionary is used (<dfn>has_dictionary</dfn>): false if 0, and true if 1.
segments.translation: |d|는 사전 사용 여부(<dfn>has_dictionary</dfn>)를 결정합니다. 0이면 거짓이고, 1이면 참입니다.

segments.source: Its data consists of the following:
Name
Type
Conditions
dictionary_index
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[If](bikeshed:=If=) [has_dictionary](bikeshed:=formula/has_dictionary=)
num_outputs
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
formula_data
[compressed_data](bikeshed:=block/compressed_data=)
If a dictionary is in use, its 0-based index is specified as [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=formula/dictionary_index=), as in data blocks.
segments.translation: 사전을 사용하는 경우, 데이터 블록에서와 마찬가지로 그 0부터 시작하는 인덱스를 [dictionary_index](bikeshed:=formula/dictionary_index=)로 지정합니다.

segments.source: [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=) is the number of outputs of the formula block, which MUST be at least 1 ([[#formula-evaluation]]).
segments.translation: [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=)는 공식 블록의 출력 개수이며, 1 이상이어야 합니다([[#formula-evaluation]]).

segments.source: Every instruction pops and pushes a number of items that its operands give, so the number of outputs follows from the instructions alone, without applying any module. [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=) tells it before [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) is decompressed, e.g. to a decompressor checking [file_output](bikeshed:=meta/file_output=) or streaming the outputs to the files using them.
segments.translation: 모든 명령은 피연산자가 정하는 개수만큼 항목을 꺼내고 넣으므로, 출력 개수는 어떤 모듈도 적용하지 않고 명령만으로 결정됩니다. [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=)는 [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=)의 압축을 해제하기 전에 이 값을 알려 줍니다. 예를 들어 [file_output](bikeshed:=meta/file_output=)을 검사하거나 출력을 그것을 사용하는 파일로 스트리밍하는 압축 해제기에 알려 줍니다.

segments.source: [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) is [checksummed Zstandard data](bikeshed:=checksummed%20Zstandard%20data=) ([[#shared-external-structure]]).
Formula blocks always use Zstandard, which can still store data verbatim with raw Zstandard blocks.
segments.translation: 공식 블록은 항상 Zstandard를 사용하며, Zstandard에서도 raw Zstandard 블록으로 데이터를 그대로 저장할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Many small formula blocks are expected to share a dictionary to compensate for the lack of shared compression context.
segments.translation: 여러 작은 공식 블록은 공유 압축 컨텍스트가 없는 것을 보완하기 위해 사전을 공유할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.source: A formula block describes the content of a file as an expression over [non-leaf items](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20items=) following it, evaluated with modules and resources preceding it.
segments.translation: 공식 블록은 파일의 내용을, 그 뒤에 오는 [비리프 항목](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20items=)에 대한 식으로 기술하며, 이 식은 그 앞에 오는 모듈과 리소스로 평가됩니다.

segments.source: The internal structure of [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) is described in Formula data ([[#formula-data]]).
Formula data
This section describes the internal structure of [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) in formula blocks ([[#formula-block]]), after it has been decompressed.
segments.translation: 이 절에서는 공식 블록([[#formula-block]])에 있는 [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=)의 압축을 해제한 후의 내부 구조를 설명합니다.

segments.source: A formula consists of the lists of blocks it references, followed by [instructions](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=) of a stack machine.
segments.translation: 공식은 그것이 참조하는 블록의 목록들과 그 뒤에 오는 스택 기계의 [명령](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=)으로 구성됩니다.

segments.source: Each instruction pops zero or more byte sequences from the stack and pushes zero or more byte sequences, and the byte sequences remaining on the stack after the last instruction are the outputs of the formula.
segments.translation: 각 명령은 스택에서 0개 이상의 바이트열을 꺼내고 0개 이상의 바이트열을 넣으며, 마지막 명령 이후 스택에 남아 있는 바이트열이 공식의 출력입니다.

segments.source: Name
Type
num_blocks
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
block_ordinal_deltas
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)[[num_blocks](bikeshed:=formula/num_blocks=)]
num_resources
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
resource_indices
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)[[num_resources](bikeshed:=formula/num_resources=)]
num_modules
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
module_indices
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)[[num_modules](bikeshed:=formula/num_modules=)]
instructions
[instruction](bikeshed:=formula/instruction=)[*]
[block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=) lists the [non-leaf items](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20items=) referenced by the formula block.

Despite their names, [num_blocks](bikeshed:=formula/num_blocks=), [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=) and [slice_block](bikeshed:=formula/slice_block=) count non-leaf items, which are blocks except for [imports](bikeshed:=import/import|=).
segments.translation: 이름과 달리 [num_blocks](bikeshed:=formula/num_blocks=), [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=), [slice_block](bikeshed:=formula/slice_block=)은 비리프 항목을 세며, 비리프 항목은 [임포트](bikeshed:=import/import|=)를 제외하면 블록입니다.

segments.source: Their 0-based ordinals among the non-leaf items supplied by the non-leaf blocks following the formula block within the [segment](bikeshed:=segment=), in the order of appearance, are |o|0 = [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=)[0] and |o||i| = |o||i| - 1 + [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=)[|i|] + 1 for |i| ≥ 1, so the ordinals are strictly increasing.
segments.translation: [세그먼트](bikeshed:=segment=) 안에서 공식 블록 뒤에 오는 비리프 블록이 제공하는 비리프 항목 사이에서 나타나는 순서에 따른 이들의 0부터 시작하는 서수는 |o|0 = [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=)[0]이고, |i| ≥ 1에 대해 |o||i| = |o||i| - 1 + [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=)[|i|] + 1이므로, 서수는 순증가합니다.

segments.source: The |i|-th <dfn>referenced item</dfn> is the non-leaf item with the ordinal |o|<sub>|i|</sub>, which MUST exist.
segments.translation: |i|번째 <dfn>참조된 항목</dfn>은 서수가 |o|<sub>|i|</sub>인 비리프 항목이며, 이 항목은 존재해야 합니다.

segments.source: [resource_indices](bikeshed:=formula/resource_indices=) and [module_indices](bikeshed:=formula/module_indices=) list the resource and module blocks referenced by the formula block, as 0-based indices within the [segment](bikeshed:=segment=) ([[#content-blocks]]).
segments.translation: [resource_indices](bikeshed:=formula/resource_indices=)와 [module_indices](bikeshed:=formula/module_indices=)는 공식 블록이 참조하는 리소스 블록과 모듈 블록을 [세그먼트](bikeshed:=segment=) 안에서의 0부터 시작하는 인덱스로 나열합니다([[#content-blocks]]).

segments.source: Each of them MUST refer to an existing block, which precedes the formula block by [[#block-order]].
segments.translation: 각 인덱스는 존재하는 블록을 가리켜야 하며, 그 블록은 [[#block-order]]에 따라 공식 블록보다 앞에 옵니다.

segments.source: [instructions](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=) fill the rest of [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=).
Each item or block listed in the above lists MUST be used by at least one instruction, and is said to be referenced by the formula block only in that case.
segments.translation: 위 목록에 나열된 각 항목 또는 블록은 적어도 하나의 명령에서 사용되어야 하며, 그 경우에만 공식 블록이 참조한다고 합니다.

segments.source: Non-leaf items are referenced by ordinals rather than by offsets, so that relocating or recompressing a block, or inserting other blocks such as mirror blocks, doesn't invalidate formula blocks referencing blocks after it.
segments.translation: 비리프 항목은 오프셋이 아니라 서수로 참조되므로, 블록을 재배치하거나 다시 압축하거나 미러 블록 같은 다른 블록을 삽입해도 그 뒤의 블록을 참조하는 공식 블록이 무효가 되지 않습니다.

segments.source: An offset would also make the result depend on how the block is located: an offset pointing into the middle of a block can still find a valid-looking block there, e.g. in an archive stored inside an uncompressed block, while a decompressor reading blocks in order would find no block at that offset.
segments.translation: 오프셋을 사용하면 결과가 블록을 찾는 방식에 따라 달라지기도 합니다. 블록 중간을 가리키는 오프셋은 예를 들어 비압축 블록 안에 저장된 아카이브에서처럼 그 위치에서 유효해 보이는 블록을 여전히 찾을 수 있지만, 블록을 순서대로 읽는 압축 해제기는 그 오프셋에서 블록을 찾지 못합니다.

segments.source: Ordinals in a typical parcel are consecutive, so [block_ordinal_deltas](bikeshed:=formula/block_ordinal_deltas=) are mostly zero.
Resources and modules are referenced by absolute indices, which recur in many formula blocks and compress well with a shared dictionary.
segments.translation: 리소스와 모듈은 절대 인덱스로 참조되며, 이 인덱스는 여러 공식 블록에서 반복되므로 공유 사전으로 잘 압축됩니다.

segments.source: Each <dfn>instruction</dfn> consists of an <dfn>opcode</dfn> of type [u8](bikeshed:=u8=) followed by its operands, whose structure is determined by the opcode as described in the following sections. [opcode](bikeshed:=formula/opcode=) MUST be one of the following:
segments.translation: 각 <dfn>명령</dfn>은 [u8](bikeshed:=u8=) 타입의 <dfn>옵코드</dfn>와 그 뒤에 오는 피연산자로 구성되며, 피연산자의 구조는 다음 절에서 설명하는 바와 같이 옵코드에 따라 결정됩니다. [opcode](bikeshed:=formula/opcode=)는 다음 중 하나여야 합니다.

segments.source: Opcode
Instruction
Pops
Pushes
00<sub>16</sub>
[Nop](bikeshed:[[#insn-nop]])

[Literal](bikeshed:[[#insn-literal]])

[Swap](bikeshed:[[#insn-swap]])
10<sub>16</sub>
[Slice](bikeshed:[[#insn-slice]])
11<sub>16</sub>
[Apply](bikeshed:[[#insn-apply]])
[apply_num_inputs](bikeshed:=formula/apply_num_inputs=)
[apply_num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/apply_num_outputs=)
12<sub>16</sub>
[Concatenate](bikeshed:[[#insn-concat]])
[concat_count](bikeshed:=formula/concat_count=)

[pack_count](bikeshed:=formula/pack_count=)

Opcodes are grouped by their roles: 00<sub>16</sub> through 0F<sub>16</sub> push data in the formula itself or rearrange the stack, 10<sub>16</sub> through 1F<sub>16</sub> compute byte sequences from [referenced items](bikeshed:=referenced%20items=) or the stack, and 20<sub>16</sub> through 2F<sub>16</sub> check them.
segments.translation: 옵코드는 역할에 따라 분류됩니다. 00<sub>16</sub>부터 0F<sub>16</sub>까지는 공식 자체에 포함된 데이터를 푸시하거나 스택을 재배열하고, 10<sub>16</sub>부터 1F<sub>16</sub>까지는 [참조 항목](bikeshed:=referenced%20items=)이나 스택으로부터 바이트열을 계산하며, 20<sub>16</sub>부터 2F<sub>16</sub>까지는 이를 검사합니다.

segments.source: Other opcodes are reserved.
Issue: A reference to a preceding block in the same segment, e.g. to patch a file stored earlier in the segment, is not yet defined.
segments.translation: Issue: 같은 세그먼트 안의 앞선 블록에 대한 참조(예: 세그먼트 앞부분에 저장된 파일을 패치하기 위한 참조)는 아직 정의되지 않았습니다.

segments.source: A reference to another file is made by an [import](bikeshed:=import/import=) ([[#import-block]]) rather than by an instruction, and the content of a file in preceding segments by an [internal import](bikeshed:=internal%20import=).
segments.translation: 다른 파일에 대한 참조는 명령이 아니라 [임포트](bikeshed:=import/import=)([[#import-block]])로 이루어지며, 선행 세그먼트에 있는 파일의 내용에 대한 참조는 [내부 임포트](bikeshed:=internal%20import=)로 이루어집니다.

segments.source: The candidate is a second list of [non-leaf items](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20items=) preceding the formula block, read by Slice instructions as [referenced items](bikeshed:=referenced%20items=) are, where the instructions of another formula block are copied when its output is needed, instead of referring to the output.
segments.translation: 후보안은 공식 블록 앞에 놓이는 두 번째 [비리프 항목](bikeshed:=non-leaf%20items=) 목록으로, Slice 명령이 [참조 항목](bikeshed:=referenced%20items=)과 같은 방식으로 읽으며, 다른 공식 블록의 출력이 필요할 때는 그 출력을 참조하는 대신 해당 공식 블록의 명령을 복사합니다.

segments.source: It requires a bound on the distance of such a reference declared before the referenced blocks, so that a streaming decompressor knows which blocks to retain, and a way to locate a preceding block without reading the segment from its beginning (`docs/xform-design.md` §7).
segments.translation: 이를 위해서는 스트리밍 압축 해제기가 어떤 블록을 유지해야 하는지 알 수 있도록 참조되는 블록보다 앞서 선언되는 이러한 참조 거리의 상한과, 세그먼트를 처음부터 읽지 않고도 앞선 블록의 위치를 찾는 방법이 필요합니다(`docs/xform-design.md` §7).

segments.source: [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) is not randomly accessible, and a decompressor is expected to read and decompress it in its entirety before evaluating any part of the formula.
segments.translation: [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=)는 임의 접근이 불가능하며, 압축 해제기는 공식의 어떤 부분이든 평가하기 전에 이를 전부 읽고 압축 해제할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.source: Every requirement on [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) that doesn't depend on the evaluated byte sequences, such as indices into the lists and the number of byte sequences on the stack, can be checked in a single pass over [instructions](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=) without evaluating anything.
segments.translation: 목록에 대한 인덱스나 스택 위 바이트열의 개수처럼 평가된 바이트열에 의존하지 않는 [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=)에 대한 모든 요구 사항은 아무것도 평가하지 않고 [명령](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=)을 한 번 훑는 것만으로 검사할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The same pass determines the length of every byte sequence on the stack, so [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) then serves as an index for random access within the output, in the same way as a seek table of other formats.
segments.translation: 같은 훑기 과정에서 스택 위 모든 바이트열의 길이가 결정되므로, [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=)는 다른 형식의 탐색 테이블과 같은 방식으로 출력 내 임의 접근을 위한 인덱스 역할을 합니다.

segments.source: The [referenced items](bikeshed:=referenced%20items=) are located by skipping blocks following the formula block by their [size](bikeshed:=block/size=) fields, and an item of an import block by decoding that block.
segments.translation: [참조 항목](bikeshed:=referenced%20items=)은 공식 블록 뒤에 오는 블록을 각각의 [size](bikeshed:=block/size=) 필드에 따라 건너뛰어 위치를 찾으며, 임포트 블록의 항목은 해당 블록을 디코딩하여 위치를 찾습니다.

segments.source: The index grows linearly with the number of non-leaf items referenced, but it compresses well because most instructions share the same shape and sizes.
segments.translation: 인덱스는 참조되는 비리프 항목의 수에 비례하여 선형으로 커지지만, 대부분의 명령이 같은 형태와 크기를 공유하므로 압축이 잘 됩니다.

segments.source: The decompression of the whole [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) is a one-time cost per file.
segments.translation: [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) 전체의 압축 해제는 파일당 한 번만 드는 비용입니다.

segments.source: To <dfn>execute an instruction</dfn> on a stack, which is a [list](bikeshed:=list=) of [byte sequences](bikeshed:=byte%20sequences=) whose last item is the top, perform the steps described for its [opcode](bikeshed:=formula/opcode=) in the following sections.
segments.translation: 마지막 항목이 맨 위인 [바이트열](bikeshed:=byte%20sequences=)의 [리스트](bikeshed:=list=)인 스택에서 <dfn>명령을 실행</dfn>하려면, 다음 절들에서 해당 [옵코드](bikeshed:=formula/opcode=)에 대해 설명하는 단계를 수행하십시오.

segments.source: To pop |n| items, the stack MUST have at least |n| items, and the last |n| items are removed from the stack and used in their order in the stack.
segments.translation: |n|개의 항목을 팝하려면 스택에 적어도 |n|개의 항목이 있어야 하며, 마지막 |n|개의 항목이 스택에서 제거되어 스택에 있던 순서대로 사용됩니다.

segments.source: Nop instruction
Opcode 00<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Nop instruction**, which has no operands and does nothing.
segments.translation: 옵코드 00<sub>16</sub>은 **Nop 명령**을 나타내며, 이 명령은 피연산자가 없고 아무 동작도 하지 않습니다.

segments.source: Literal instruction
Opcode 01<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Literal instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
literal_size
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
literal_data
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[[literal_size](bikeshed:=formula/literal_size=)]
It pushes [literal_data](bikeshed:=formula/literal_data=).
Swap instruction
Opcode 0F<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Swap instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
swap_depth
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
The stack MUST have more than [swap_depth](bikeshed:=formula/swap_depth=) items.
It exchanges the top of the stack with the item [swap_depth](bikeshed:=formula/swap_depth=) items below it.
segments.translation: 이 명령은 스택의 맨 위 항목을 그보다 [swap_depth](bikeshed:=formula/swap_depth=)개 아래에 있는 항목과 교환합니다.

segments.source: Slice instruction
Opcode 10<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Slice instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
slice_block
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
slice_start
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
slice_length
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
[slice_block](bikeshed:=formula/slice_block=) MUST be less than [num_blocks](bikeshed:=formula/num_blocks=).
Let |c| be the [stored content](bikeshed:=stored%20content=) of the [slice_block](bikeshed:=formula/slice_block=)-th [referenced item](bikeshed:=referenced%20item=).
[slice_start](bikeshed:=formula/slice_start=) + [slice_length](bikeshed:=formula/slice_length=) MUST be at most the length of |c|.
Push the bytes of |c| in [[slice_start](bikeshed:=formula/slice_start=), [slice_start](bikeshed:=formula/slice_start=) + [slice_length](bikeshed:=formula/slice_length=)).
Apply instruction
Opcode 11<sub>16</sub> denotes an **Apply instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
apply_module
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
apply_num_resources
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
apply_resources
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)[[apply_num_resources](bikeshed:=formula/apply_num_resources=)]
apply_params_size
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
apply_params
[u8](bikeshed:=u8=)[[apply_params_size](bikeshed:=formula/apply_params_size=)]
apply_memory_limit
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
apply_num_inputs
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
apply_num_outputs
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
apply_output_sizes
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)[[apply_num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/apply_num_outputs=)]

[apply_module](bikeshed:=formula/apply_module=) MUST be less than [num_modules](bikeshed:=formula/num_modules=), and each item of [apply_resources](bikeshed:=formula/apply_resources=) MUST be less than [num_resources](bikeshed:=formula/num_resources=).
segments.translation: [apply_module](bikeshed:=formula/apply_module=)는 [num_modules](bikeshed:=formula/num_modules=)보다 작아야 하며, [apply_resources](bikeshed:=formula/apply_resources=)의 각 항목은 [num_resources](bikeshed:=formula/num_resources=)보다 작아야 합니다.

segments.source: [apply_num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/apply_num_outputs=) MUST be at least 1.
Pop [apply_num_inputs](bikeshed:=formula/apply_num_inputs=) items as |inputs|.

Let |outputs| be the result of [applying](bikeshed:=apply%20a%20module|=) the module block at [module_indices](bikeshed:=formula/module_indices=)[[apply_module](bikeshed:=formula/apply_module=)] with |inputs|, the resource blocks at [resource_indices](bikeshed:=formula/resource_indices=)[|r|] for each |r| of [apply_resources](bikeshed:=formula/apply_resources=), [apply_params](bikeshed:=formula/apply_params=), [apply_output_sizes](bikeshed:=formula/apply_output_sizes=) and [apply_memory_limit](bikeshed:=formula/apply_memory_limit=) ([[#module-execution]]).
segments.translation: |outputs|를 [module_indices](bikeshed:=formula/module_indices=)[[apply_module](bikeshed:=formula/apply_module=)]에 있는 모듈 블록을 |inputs|, [apply_resources](bikeshed:=formula/apply_resources=)의 각 |r|에 대해 [resource_indices](bikeshed:=formula/resource_indices=)[|r|]에 있는 리소스 블록, [apply_params](bikeshed:=formula/apply_params=), [apply_output_sizes](bikeshed:=formula/apply_output_sizes=), [apply_memory_limit](bikeshed:=formula/apply_memory_limit=)와 함께 [적용](bikeshed:=apply%20a%20module|=)한 결과로 둡니다([[#module-execution]]).

segments.source: Push each item of |outputs| in order.
Concatenate instruction
Opcode 12<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Concatenate instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
concat_count
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
It pops [concat_count](bikeshed:=formula/concat_count=) items and pushes their concatenation in order.
segments.translation: 이 명령은 [concat_count](bikeshed:=formula/concat_count=)개의 항목을 꺼내고, 이들을 순서대로 연결한 결과를 넣습니다.

segments.source: Pack instruction
Opcode 13<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Pack instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
pack_count
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
It pops [pack_count](bikeshed:=formula/pack_count=) items and pushes the [packed byte sequence](bikeshed:=packed%20byte%20sequence=) of them in order ([[#packed-byte-sequences]]).
Split instruction
Opcode 14<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Split instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
split_count
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
split_sizes
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)[[split_count](bikeshed:=formula/split_count=)]
[split_count](bikeshed:=formula/split_count=) MUST be at least 1.
Pop an item |x|.
The sum of [split_sizes](bikeshed:=formula/split_sizes=) MUST be equal to the length of |x|.
For each |n| of [split_sizes](bikeshed:=formula/split_sizes=) in order, push the next |n| bytes of |x|.
Patch instruction
Opcode 15<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Patch instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
patch_size
[leb128](bikeshed:=leb128=)
Pop 2 items as |source| and |patch|.

|patch| MUST consist of one or more [Zstandard blocks](bikeshed:=Zstandard%20blocks=) without any other bytes, where only the last block is signalled as the final block by its block header, and each block holds at most 128 KiB of data.
segments.translation: |patch|는 다른 바이트 없이 하나 이상의 [Zstandard 블록](bikeshed:=Zstandard%20blocks=)으로 구성되어야 하며, 마지막 블록만 블록 헤더에서 최종 블록으로 표시되고, 각 블록은 최대 128 KiB의 데이터를 담습니다.

segments.source: Let |output| be the result of decompressing |patch| as a sequence of Zstandard blocks [[!RFC8878]] with |source| as the `Content` of a raw content dictionary, i.e. the entropy tables start empty and the repeat offsets start at their initial values (1, 4, 8).
segments.translation: |output|을 |source|를 원시 내용 사전의 `Content`로 하여 |patch|를 Zstandard 블록 [[!RFC8878]]의 시퀀스로 압축 해제한 결과라고 합니다. 즉, 엔트로피 테이블은 빈 상태로 시작하고 반복 오프셋은 초깃값(1, 4, 8)으로 시작합니다.

segments.source: The offset of every match MUST be at most the length of |source| plus the number of bytes already decompressed.
segments.translation: 모든 매치의 오프셋은 |source|의 길이와 이미 압축 해제된 바이트 수를 더한 값 이하여야 합니다.

segments.source: The length of |output| MUST be [patch_size](bikeshed:=formula/patch_size=).
Push |output|.
A Patch instruction decompresses Zstandard blocks with an earlier byte sequence as a raw content dictionary, as `zstd --patch-from` does, so a decompressor reuses its Zstandard decompressor for it.
segments.translation: Patch 명령은 `zstd --patch-from`과 마찬가지로 이전 바이트열을 원시 내용 사전으로 하여 Zstandard 블록을 압축 해제하므로, 압축 해제기는 이를 위해 자신의 Zstandard 압축 해제기를 재사용합니다.

segments.source: The earlier byte sequence is an operand on the stack rather than a [dictionary block](bikeshed:[[#dictionary-block]]), so that it can be any byte sequence computed by the formula, e.g. an [import](bikeshed:=import/import=) or a stream split from it by a module.
segments.translation: 앞선 바이트열은 [사전 블록](bikeshed:[[#dictionary-block]])이 아니라 스택 위의 피연산자이므로, 공식이 계산한 임의의 바이트열, 예를 들어 [임포트](bikeshed:=import/import=)나 모듈이 그로부터 분할한 스트림이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The patch itself is typically a slice of an uncompressed non-leaf data block, whose checksum covers the stored patch, while an [output checksum](bikeshed:=output%20checksum=) covers the result.
segments.translation: 패치 자체는 일반적으로 압축되지 않은 비리프 데이터 블록의 슬라이스이며, 그 체크섬은 저장된 패치를 대상으로 하고, [출력 체크섬](bikeshed:=output%20checksum=)은 결과를 대상으로 합니다.

segments.source: A Patch instruction has no Zstandard frame and therefore no `Window_Size`: a match may refer to any byte of |source| or of the output so far, and the guaranteed limit of `Window_Size` in [[#zstandard-compression-method]] doesn't apply.
segments.translation: Patch 명령에는 Zstandard 프레임이 없으므로 `Window_Size`도 없습니다. 매치는 |source|의 어떤 바이트나 지금까지의 출력의 어떤 바이트든 참조할 수 있으며, [[#zstandard-compression-method]]에서 보장하는 `Window_Size`의 한도는 적용되지 않습니다.

segments.source: The decompressor holds both byte sequences anyway, so a long reach costs no additional memory.
segments.translation: 압축 해제기는 어차피 두 바이트열을 모두 보유하고 있으므로, 먼 거리를 참조하더라도 추가 메모리가 들지 않습니다.

segments.source: With libzstd, this is decompressing a frame after `ZSTD_DCtx_refPrefix` with |source|, whose release builds only check offsets against the start of the prefix; a decompressor enforcing `Window_Size` has to lift that check for the frame.
segments.translation: libzstd에서는 이것이 |source|로 `ZSTD_DCtx_refPrefix`를 호출한 뒤 프레임을 압축 해제하는 것에 해당하며, 그 릴리스 빌드는 오프셋을 프리픽스의 시작 위치에 대해서만 검사합니다. `Window_Size`를 강제하는 압축 해제기는 해당 프레임에 대해 그 검사를 해제해야 합니다.

segments.source: A compressor using libzstd sets `ZSTD_c_windowLog` large enough to cover |source| and the output, as `zstd --patch-from` does.
segments.translation: libzstd를 사용하는 압축기는 `zstd --patch-from`과 마찬가지로 `ZSTD_c_windowLog`를 |source|와 출력을 포괄할 만큼 크게 설정합니다.

segments.source: Checksum instruction
Opcode 20<sub>16</sub> denotes a **Checksum instruction**.
Its operands consist of the following:
Name
Type
checksum_value
[u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=)
The stack MUST NOT be empty.
The [XXH64](bikeshed:[[#xxh64-checksum-method]]) checksum of the top of the stack MUST be equal to [checksum_value](bikeshed:=formula/checksum_value=).
A Checksum instruction <dfn>covers</dfn> the byte sequence at the top of the stack when it is executed, and the byte sequence remains the same item when moved by Swap instructions.
segments.translation: Checksum 명령은 실행될 때 스택 최상단에 있는 바이트열을 <dfn>포괄</dfn>하며, 그 바이트열은 Swap 명령으로 이동되어도 같은 항목으로 유지됩니다.

segments.source: An <dfn>output checksum</dfn> is a Checksum instruction [covering](bikeshed:=covers|=) an output of the formula block.
segments.translation: <dfn>출력 체크섬</dfn>은 공식 블록의 출력을 [포괄](bikeshed:=covers|=)하는 Checksum 명령입니다.

segments.source: Formula evaluation
To <dfn>evaluate a formula block</dfn> |block|:
Let |data| be the [decoded data](bikeshed:=decoded%20data=) of [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=) of |block|, parsed as in [[#formula-data]].
segments.translation: 블록 |block|의 [formula_data](bikeshed:=formula/formula_data=)의 [디코딩된 데이터](bikeshed:=decoded%20data=)를 [[#formula-data]]에서와 같이 파싱한 것을 |data|로 둡니다.

segments.source: Let |stack| be an empty [list](bikeshed:=list=) of [byte sequences](bikeshed:=byte%20sequences=).

For each |insn| of [instructions](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=) of |data| in order, [execute](bikeshed:=execute%20an%20instruction|=) |insn| on |stack| as described for its [opcode](bikeshed:=formula/opcode=) in [[#formula-data]].
segments.translation: |data|의 [명령](bikeshed:=formula/instructions=)의 각 |insn|에 대해 순서대로, [[#formula-data]]에서 해당 [옵코드](bikeshed:=formula/opcode=)에 대해 기술된 대로 스택 |stack|에서 |insn|을 [실행](bikeshed:=execute%20an%20instruction|=)합니다.

segments.source: The number of items of |stack| MUST be [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=) of |block|.
segments.translation: 스택 |stack|의 항목 수는 블록 |block|의 [num_outputs](bikeshed:=formula/num_outputs=)와 같아야 합니다.

segments.source: Return |stack| as the outputs of |block|, numbered from 0 in order from the bottom of the stack.
segments.translation: |stack|을 블록 |block|의 출력으로 반환하며, 출력에는 스택의 맨 아래부터 순서대로 0부터 번호를 매깁니다.

segments.source: Every byte sequence on the stack is used exactly once, as an input of another instruction or as an output, so a formula is a tree of instructions rooted at its outputs, except that an instruction pushing multiple items, an Apply or a Split instruction, is shared by them.
segments.translation: 스택 위의 모든 바이트열은 다른 명령의 입력이나 출력으로서 정확히 한 번 사용되므로, 공식은 출력을 루트로 하는 명령의 트리입니다. 다만 여러 항목을 푸시하는 명령, 즉 Apply 명령이나 Split 명령은 그 항목들이 공유합니다.

segments.source: Byte sequences are defined as fully evaluated values.
Lazy, streaming or partial evaluation is an implementation strategy and doesn't change the result ([[#partial-access]]).
segments.translation: 지연 평가, 스트리밍 평가 또는 부분 평가는 구현 전략이며 결과를 바꾸지 않습니다([[#partial-access]]).

segments.source: A Checksum instruction covering an intermediate byte sequence, such as the output of an Apply instruction, can be verified by a decompressor that has computed that byte sequence but not the entire output.
segments.translation: Apply 명령의 출력과 같은 중간 바이트열을 포괄하는 Checksum 명령은, 전체 출력은 계산하지 않고 그 바이트열만 계산한 압축 해제기도 검증할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Packed byte sequences
The <dfn>packed byte sequence</dfn> of a [list](bikeshed:=list=) of [byte sequences](bikeshed:=byte%20sequences=) |items| is the concatenation of the following, where |n| is the number of |items|:
segments.translation: [바이트열](bikeshed:=byte%20sequences=)의 [리스트](bikeshed:=list=) |items|의 <dfn>패킹된 바이트열</dfn>은 다음을 연결한 것이며, 여기서 |n|은 |items|의 개수입니다.

segments.source: |n| as [u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=);
For each |i| in [0, |n|), the sum of the lengths of |items|[0] through |items|[|i|] as [u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=);
segments.translation: [0, |n|)의 각 |i|에 대해, |items|[0]부터 |items|[|i|]까지의 길이의 합을 [u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=)로 나타낸 것.

segments.source: Each item of |items| in order.
A byte sequence |p| is a packed byte sequence of exactly one [list](bikeshed:=list=) |items|, if any.
segments.translation: 바이트열 |p|는, 그러한 것이 있다면, 정확히 하나의 [리스트](bikeshed:=list=) |items|의 패킹된 바이트열입니다.

segments.source: To <dfn>unpack</dfn> |p|:
If |p| is shorter than 8 bytes, return failure.
Let |n| be the first 8 bytes of |p| as [u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=), and let |h| be 8 × (|n| + 1).
If |h| exceeds the length of |p|, return failure.
Let |e|<sub>|i|</sub> be the 8 bytes of |p| from the offset 8 × (|i| + 1) as [u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=) for each |i| in [0, |n|), and let |e|<sub>-1</sub> be 0.
segments.translation: [0, |n|)의 각 |i|에 대해 |e|<sub>|i|</sub>를 오프셋 8 × (|i| + 1)부터 시작하는 |p|의 8 바이트를 [u64le](bikeshed:=u64le=)로 읽은 값이라고 하고, |e|<sub>-1</sub>을 0이라고 합니다.

segments.source: If |e|<sub>|i| - 1</sub> > |e|<sub>|i|</sub> for any |i| in [0, |n|), return failure.
If |h| + |e|<sub>|n| - 1</sub> is not the length of |p|, return failure.
Return the [list](bikeshed:=list=) of the bytes of |p| in [|h| + |e|<sub>|i| - 1</sub>, |h| + |e|<sub>|i|</sub>) for each |i| in [0, |n|).
segments.translation: [0, |n|)의 각 |i|에 대해 [|h| + |e|<sub>|i| - 1</sub>, |h| + |e|<sub>|i|</sub>) 범위에 있는 |p|의 바이트들로 이루어진 [리스트](bikeshed:=list=)를 반환합니다.

segments.source: Packed byte sequences let a module take a list of byte sequences whose number varies between applications, e.g. one per section of an executable, as a single input, since the number of inputs of a module is fixed by its [entry point](bikeshed:=entry%20point=) ([[#module-execution]]).
